Nine to Five summary

Welcome to the RatRace. Nolimit City takes a satirical look at the daily corporate grind in the Nine to Five slot. The action takes place inside a retro office cubicle on a five by four grid layout that provides 1024 base ways to win. You will encounter annoying managers, fax machines, and endless paperwork as you try to climb the corporate ladder. If you want to experience this comedic take on office life without dipping into your actual paycheck, you can play for free right here on Playin.com.

Base Game Mechanics and Features

The base game perfectly captures the chaotic energy of the workplace. You will frequently encounter the xWays mechanic, which lands and reveals two to four matching symbols to significantly boost your win ways. The trademark xNudge Wilds appear on the middle reels, always bumping upwards or downwards to become fully visible while increasing your multiplier. Once fully stacked, they can even nudge up to nine additional steps. Regular Wilds can also land, acting as either a Green Wild with a random multiplier up to five or a completely useless Red Wild. Players can also toggle the xBet feature to pay a slightly increased stake, which blocks the final reel but drastically improves the odds of triggering the bonus rounds.

Bonus Rounds and Free Spins

Finding three scatter symbols promotes you to ten Middle Management Spins. During this round, Layoff symbols increase your overall win multiplier, while Lawsuit symbols decrease it. Landing four scatters awards the top tier Ivory Tower Spins with twelve free spins. In this executive mode, the Tech Layoff symbol adds to your multiplier and doubles the value of the next Tech Layoff, but you must avoid the Ctrl Alt Del symbol which divides that incoming value by four. You can also hunt for the ultimate promotion via the God Mode feature, which immediately awards the top prize if you land the fully stacked mega symbol. Practice your corporate strategy by entering a free slot tournament to compete against your coworkers for real rewards.

Volatility Rating and Potential

Unlike the usual extreme releases from Nolimit City, this corporate adventure comes with a High volatility rating. The absolute maximum win potential, known as the Big Win Not Found payout, reaches 9,217 times your base bet. Because the office politics and multiplier mechanics can be quite unpredictable, testing the waters with virtual currency is a great idea. Utilizing your Playin coins allows you to figure out how the different bonus tiers and wild symbols function entirely risk free before you ever decide to play with real funds.

If you’ve ever worked in an office in the 90s, you’ll appreciate the effort Nolimit City has made with the Nine to Five slot. Graphically, it brings back memories of Beavis and Butt-head and The Office television series (by Ricky Gervais). That evokes the mundane nature of these types of environments which are reinforced by the dial-up internet sounds and office equipment that has become redundant these days. From an aesthetic point of view, NLC has delivered yet again with a unique take on a possibly boring subject matter. In terms of the gameplay, yellow ID Wilds can give you nothing (Red Wild) or a Green Wild with a random multiplier up to 5x. The xNudge Wild nudges and increases the win multiplier which can give you big wins if you manage to land multiple xNudge Wilds. xWays are pretty standard these days but they do increase the number of ways and display the same symbol. The 2 free spins features see special symbols increase or decrease the win multiplier up 9,999x. Nothing unique here. In the base game though, landing the Mega symbol fully in view will award you the max payout (9,217 x bet). If you’re a non-UK player, you can opt for the God Mode for 1,370 x bet and get 1 spin in the hope you land this illusive Mega symbol. With 9,217 x bet max wins, Nine to Five isn’t Nolimit City’s best-paying slot by any stretch of the imagination. That said, the max win probability is 1 in 148,000 spins in the base game. This is significantly lower than other NLC games. To compare, Tombstone RIP offers a max win of 300,000 x bet that will be won every 130 million spins. I found this game entertaining from a thematic point of view. The xBet feature represents good value as it costs 10% more per spin and more than doubles your chances of triggering a free spins feature. I would recommend this to UK players with the bonus buy options not available. In summary, the Nine to Five slot can be as much a slog as it is to work in these kinds of environments. If you manage to keep on the right side of your manager and get lucky with xNudge Wilds and win multipliers, it can see you reap the benefits of the rat race. At times, however, it will feel like you’re stuck in your cubicle with nowhere to run.

Game Features

xNudge® Wild

The xNudge® Wild symbols can only land on reels 2-5. Landing xNudge® Wild will always nudge to fully visible. Each nudge increases the win multiplier by 1. Once it covers the reel, it will also nudge additional 0-9 steps. Several xNudge® Wild multipliers multiply with each other for a total Nudge multiplier.

xWays®

Reveals 2-4 symbols of the same kind. It can reveal any paying symbol. If more than one xWays symbol, then all xWays symbols will reveal the same symbol.

xBet®

At a cost of an extra +10% on the base bet, the last reel will be blocked with increased chances of landing Scatter. Increases the chance of entering Middle Management/Ivory Tower Spins by more than 2 times. The payout for each symbol is not affected.

Wilds

Wild symbols can only land on reels 2-5 and transform into: Green Wild: an active Wild symbol with a random symbol multiplier ranging 1×- 5x. Red Wild: a dead symbol.

Scatters

Scatter symbols will only land on reels 2-5. Landing 3 Scatter symbols will trigger 10 Middle Management Spins. Landing 4 Scatter symbols will trigger 12 Ivory Tower Spins.

Middle Management Spins

Layoff and Lawsuit symbols can land. Lawsuit symbol acts before the Layoff symbol. Each Layoff symbol will increase the win multiplier by 1 whereas each Lawsuit symbol will decrease it by 1. Tech Layoff multiplier which will act during Ivory Tower Spins gets doubled when Layoff symbol lands. The multiplier value can never go below 1 or above 9999. The win multiplier is applied at the end of the round. Landing Overtime symbol will award +1 spin per symbol. Landing 2 or more Overtime symbols in the same spin will also upgrade the bonus mode to Ivory Tower Spins.

GOD MODE

Chase Big Win Not Found by landing a Mega symbol on the reels at a cost of 1370 times bet.

Ivory Tower Spins

Instead of Layoff and Lawsuit symbols, Tech Layoff and ‘CtrI+Alt+Del’ symbols can land. ‘Ctrl+Alt+Del’ symbol acts before the Tech Layoff symbol. The Tech Layoff symbol will add a win multiplier and then the value of the next Tech Layoff multiplier is doubled. The initial and minimum value of these multipliers is 1, the maximum value is 9999. The win multiplier is applied at the end of the round. The ‘Ctrl+Alt+Del’ symbol divides the value of the next Tech Layoff by 4 (rounded down to nearest integer). Landing Overtime symbol will award +1 spin per symbol.

Big Win Not Found

The max payout of the game is 9217 times the base bet. When the total win exceeds this amount the game round will end and 9217 times the base bet is awarded. Big Win Not Found could also be achieved in main game by landing the mega symbol fully stacked on reels.

Nolimit Bonus Buy

Buy your way straight into the different bonus features, ranging from 75 to 1370 times the base bet. • 10 Middle Management Spins can be bought for 75 times bet, maximum possible bet is €280.00. • 12 Ivory Tower Spins can be bought for 200 times the bet, maximum possible bet is €280.00. • GOD MODE Feature can be bought for 1370 times the bet, maximum possible bet is €280.00. • Lucky Draw can be bought for 125 times the bet, maximum possible bet is €280.00.

The Nolimit Bonus feature may however be removed in some regulated markets.

Game xMechanics

xBet®

At an extra cost per spin, the player gets an increased chance of getting into the Bonus Modes. The way this happens varies from game to game. The payout for each symbol is not affected.

xWays®

xWays® unlocks unprecedented win potential for players. Usually seen in a fixed Ways game, any xWays symbols that land reveals a stack of the same symbol, increasing the ways available to win, and when working alongside some of the other mechanics available in this series, such as xNudge or xSplit, can pave the way for some huge wins. xWays® first made an appearance in Pixies Vs Pirates, although many players will more likely recognise this mechanic from Punk Rocker, an early 2020 release. Alongside these two releases, xWays has made an appearance in a host of other NolimitCity games, including Dragon Tribe, East Coast vs West Coast, and San Quentin – the early 2021 release which rocked the community with news of a 150,000x maximum win availability.

xNudge®

xNudge®: A simple yet effective feature that turns any game into a massive potential bearing title! xNudge works alongside wild reels, wherein landing a wild in view has the potential to increase the multiplier attached, as the wild nudges to fill the entire reel. If the wild is not centred in the reel, it will either nudge up or down, incrementing its multiplier by 1 for each nudge.

xGOD®

The most potent feature to date in the Nolimit City xMechanic portfolio. xGod® was first introduced in the game Nine to Five, released in November 2023. xGod® is a powerful single feature capable of delivering the max win in an instant. May trigger the max win in the base game or the bonus modes - without the assistance of any other features in the game or wins in the game.
